note: Per subject state S (every state of every imported block) and per probe, the set of candidate states X (air plus every state of every imported block) for which S.canSurvive(level, P) is true in a world holding only S at P and X at the probed neighbour cell, air elsewhere, block light and sky light 15. Rows are [west, east, north, south, down, up, down_water, down_dark]: the first six put X at P + that direction; down_water puts X below with water sources at the four horizontal neighbours of that support cell (sugar cane's rule); down_dark puts X below with light 0 (the mushrooms' rule). Each entry is a signature id into signatures; identical sets share one, numbered by first appearance, 0 = no candidate. A signature maps a block id to "all" (every state of the block passes) or to the ascending state indices within that block (its state order in block_states.json, 0-based); blocks with no passing state are absent; air is the block id "air". Subjects are listed by block id in ids order, one entry per state in state order.
